from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal document to support filtering."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the legal document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal case category (e.g., 刑事，民事，行政)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or criminal charge as named in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., 判决书，裁定书，决定书)")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the cause or document type for grounding")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    legal_documents: list[LegalDocument]
